about_the_game:
This is a huge project that I have been working on for a long time with a bunch of other people. The premise is that a lot of people work in this Discord server that write our own main character story and eventually we all collab and take down vilians. This is basically an anime story. Each main character have powers and they are refer to as "Externals".

This is a RPG Maker MV game with over 100+ hours of content for now. After each saga, I will update the game. There are 5 sagas for now and there are a bunch of unfinished stories but I will update as they drop chapters.

I hope you enjoy this story-rich game with a lot of hard fights. It is a top-down RPG game.

This game includes:

-Deep and lore base story.

-Over 30+ Main characters with their own stories you can play with.

-Over 100+ hours of content.

-Free roam mode where you can go to any map that is in the game.

-Unique side quests.

-Infinite dungeon for grinding.

-A gacha system that you use in game money to get over 1,000+ characters and coins to upgrade your stats.

-A customization for your custom character.

-A lot of reading.

-Easter eggs.

content_descriptors.notes: There is intense gory scenes and cursing as well as the use of alcohol and smoking
